receipt_reconstructed.derivation_note: The real-ledger qualification run wrote this receipt; a later SCRATCH run of _debug_suite.py then overwrote it, because that harness redirected only the two guard ledgers and left this receipt and the quarantine archive on the real paths. Every aggregate number below is read fresh from the durable files. The per-update detail list is carried over from the preserved scratch copy and is labelled as such: it cannot be independently re-derived without re-spending this round's synthetic optimizer-step budget, which is already exhausted.

forward_rows.note: read fresh from the durable ledger. The real run's own receipt reported 12 rows / 0 charged here because it read the in-process ledger instance the suite opened in setUpClass, which never advances: every charge builds its own ledger object. Corrected in code and recorded, not hidden.

gate trunk input rows only; ROUND73 runs no offline fit. Read from a FRESH ledger object over the durable state file, never from the instance the suite opened in setUpClass, because every charge constructs its own ledger object and the held instance would report a stale row count.
